features.name: Attached debugger from client
features.description: New capability in Business Central release allowing developers to directly attach the debugger to a session from the client without configuration files, running the current project scope.

features.name: Actionable errors
features.description: New feature in Business Central allowing developers to make error messages actionable, providing more context and suggested actions to users when errors occur.
caveats: the developer already started to use this but missed on this error

features.name: GitHub Copilot integration
features.description: AI-powered code assistance integrated into Business Central development, providing intelligent code suggestions and error message generation in the context of the developer's work.
caveats: recommendation to check the generated code once or twice before using

features.name: Page inspector
features.description: Development tool that allows developers to inspect a page directly from the client, showing page name, items, and fields, enabling quick navigation to the relevant code.

features.name: Copilot Chat for code explanation
features.description: AI assistant feature that can explain complex code segments in natural language, helping developers understand what specific code checks and validations are performing.

features.name: Telemetry capture for errors
features.description: Automatic capture of error information in telemetry when users encounter errors in the application, allowing operators to receive notifications and investigate issues.

features.name: Embedding Power BI visuals in pages
features.description: Capability to select a Power BI visual and embed it directly into a Business Central page without navigating away, keeping the data context within the page. The feature uses a fact box and trigger mechanism requiring report ID and visual ID.
caveats: requires adding a fact box and trigger
requires finding report ID and visual ID
Requires BC samples documentation and guidelines

features.name: Power user page customization without development tools
features.description: Power users with appropriate permissions can add fields to pages directly through the Business Central interface without using Visual Studio Code or writing code. The customization mode provides an intuitive interface with plus buttons and field filtering.
caveats: Requires admin permission to invoke customization action
Permission-based - not all users can customize by default

features.name: AL-GO integration for deploying customizations to production
features.description: Customizations made in sandbox can be submitted to a GitHub repository empowered by AL-GO, which automates quality checks including code compatibility, performance testing, and peer review before publishing to production environments.
caveats: Cannot directly copy code from sandbox to production
